turns.customer: The Thicket fleece from order #1087 has a big snag and a hole in the sleeve. It was like that when I opened the package. I'd like a refund.
turns.reply:
I've sent this to a support agent. Because the report came in just after the 14-day window, they'll review it case by case.

A human agent will follow up with you by email, usually within one business day, on ticket **ESC-7**. They can take it from there regarding the refund. No need to return the damaged item unless they ask.

Thanks for your patience.
